title: rollupfield
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, metricid, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby.

createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

dateattribute.description: Select a date field for the selected record type, such as Actual Closed Date for the Opportunity record type.

entityfordateattribute.description: Select the record type that contains the date field that will be considered while rolling up data to the goal.

goalattribute.description: Select a rollup field where the metric rollup data will be displayed in the goal.

importsequencenumber.description: Sequence number of the import that created this record.

isstateparententityattribute.description: Tells whether the state or status belongs to the parent entity.

modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated.

rollupfieldid.description: Unique identifier of the rollup field.

sourceattribute.description: Type the name of the field that the data for the goal rolls up from.

sourceentity.description: Type the name of the record type (entity) that the data for the goal must roll up from.

sourcestate.description: Select the state of the records you want to use as the source of the rollup data for the metric.

sourcestatus.description: Select the status of the records you want to use as the source of the rollup data for the metric.

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

versionnumber.description: Version number of the rollup field.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_metricid_value.description: Unique identifier of the goal metric associated with the rollup field.

_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record on behalf of another user.
